content: अवन्तिः, -न्ती {%f.%} [अव-बाहु˚ झिच् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 50.</ls>] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a city, the modern उज्जयिनी, one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, to die at which is said to secure eternal happiness; <ab>cf.</ab> अयोध्या मथुरा माया काशी काञ्चिरवन्तिका . पुरी द्वारावती चैव सप्तैता मोक्षदायिकाः .. The women of Avanti are said to be very skilful in all erotic arts; <ab>cf.</ab> आवन्त्य एव निपुणाः सुदृशो रतकर्मणि <ls>B. R. 10. 82</ls>. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a river. {%m.%} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a country and its inhabitants; its capital being उज्जयिनी on the river सिप्रा; and there is also the temple of महाकाल in the suburbs. [According to Hemacandra अवन्ति is synonymous with Mālava or the modern Mālavā; but the latter country covered in ancient times, as now, a wider area than Avanti, as Bāṇa applies the name to a neighbouring kingdom in the east, whose capital was Vidiśā on the Vetravatī or Betvā. In the time of the Mahābhārata Avanti appears to have extended on the south to the banks of the Narmadā and on the west probably to the banks of the Myhe or Mahī]; अवन्तिनाथोऽयमुदग्राबाहुः <ls>R. 6. 32</ls>; असौ महाकालनिकेतनस्य वसन्नदूरे किल चन्द्रमौलेः <ls n="R.">6. 34</ls>, <ls n="R. 6.">35</ls>; प्राप्यावन्तीनुदयनकथाकोविदग्रामवृद्धान् <ls>Me. 30</ls>; अवन्तीषूज्जयिनी नाम नगरी <ls>K. 52</ls>.
